jobs.title: Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development. Our 20,500 employees operate across over 100 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organization of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.

Job Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Risk Analyst to join our organization in AlUla, Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating organizational risks across various business functions. You will work collaboratively with stakeholders to develop comprehensive risk assessments, implement risk management strategies, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical capabilities, exceptional organizational skills, and a commitment to maintaining the highest professional standards.

Conduct comprehensive risk assessments and analyses across business operations, identifying potential threats and vulnerabilities
Plan and perform QSRAs
using project schedules, logic, calendars, constraints, milestones, and critical paths.
Plan and perform QCRAs
using cost estimates, cost breakdown structures, assumptions, allowances, and estimating uncertainty.
Perform Monte Carlo simulations to quantify cost exposure and determine P50, P80, P90,
and contingency requirements.
Active Risk Manager (ARM):
Manage risk registers, risk breakdown structures, qualitative and quantitative risk models, simulations, reporting, dashboards, and mitigation tracking.
Palisade @RISK:
Develop cost and schedule risk models in Excel, apply probability distributions, perform Monte Carlo simulations, and conduct sensitivity, tornado, contribution, and correlation analysis.
Primavera Risk Analysis (PRA):
Prepare P6 schedules for risk analysis, develop schedule risk models, perform Monte Carlo simulations, and analyze criticality, schedule drivers, and P50/P80/P90 completion dates.
Analyze financial data and business metrics to evaluate risk exposure and trends
Create detailed risk reports and presentations for senior management and stakeholders
Monitor compliance with regulatory requirements and internal risk management policies
Collaborate with department heads and operational teams to understand business processes and associated risks
Recommend risk mitigation strategies and controls to reduce organizational exposure
Perform quantitative and qualitative risk modeling and analysis using appropriate tools and methodologies

Qualifications

​​​​​​Essential Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Risk Management, Construction Management,
or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience
in project risk management, project controls, or quantitative risk analysis.
Demonstrable hands-on experience conducting QSRAs and QCRAs
.
Practical experience using Active Risk Manager (ARM)
.
Strong working experience with Palisade @RISK
.
Strong working experience with Primavera Risk Analysis (PRA)
.
Experience with Monte Carlo simulation and probabilistic risk modelling
.
Strong understanding of project schedules, cost estimates, risk registers, and project controls.
Experience analyzing probability distributions, confidence levels, risk exposure, sensitivity, and risk drivers.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with Primavera P6
and integration of schedule data into quantitative risk models.
Experience of major capital projects, infrastructure, construction, energy, oil & gas, transportation, or similar industries.
Professional certification such as PMP
, PMI-RMP, APM, IRM
, or equivalent.
Knowledge of ISO 31000
and recognized project risk management practices.
Experience with project contingency management and risk-based forecasting.

jobs.company: Arabic and Islamic Education Conference - Dubai College
jobs.title: Credit Analyst | Loan Officer
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
💳 We’re Hiring: Credit Analyst | Loan Officer 🕒 Employment Type:
Full-Time
💼 Level:
Mid-Level
We are looking for a detail-oriented and customer-focused Credit Analyst | Loan Officer
to evaluate credit applications, assess financial risk, support lending decisions, and guide customers through the loan application process. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with excellent communication and relationship-management abilities.
🎯 Key Responsibilities • Review and assess loan and credit applications in accordance with company lending policies.
• Analyze applicants’ financial statements, income, assets, liabilities, credit history, and repayment capacity.
• Conduct detailed credit risk assessments and identify potential financial risks.
• Verify customer information, supporting documents, employment details, income sources, and financial records.
• Evaluate credit scores, debt-to-income ratios, cash flow, collateral, and other relevant financial indicators.
• Recommend loan approvals, declines, limits, pricing, and appropriate lending conditions based on credit assessments.
• Conduct customer interviews to understand financial needs, objectives, and repayment capabilities.
• Explain loan products, interest rates, repayment schedules, fees, terms, and conditions to customers.
• Guide customers through the complete loan application and approval process.
• Prepare accurate credit assessment reports, loan recommendations, and supporting documentation.
• Review existing customer accounts and monitor credit performance and repayment behavior.
• Identify early warning signs of potential defaults, financial distress, or credit deterioration.
• Work closely with underwriting, risk, compliance, operations, and collections teams.
• Ensure all credit decisions are supported by accurate and complete documentation.
• Maintain compliance with internal credit policies, lending guidelines, and applicable regulations.
• Monitor loan portfolios and provide recommendations for risk mitigation where required.
• Conduct financial and industry research to support credit decisions.
• Analyze market conditions and economic trends that may affect borrower creditworthiness.
• Follow up with customers regarding missing documents, application status, approvals, and loan conditions.
• Maintain professional relationships with existing and prospective borrowers.
• Support business development by identifying suitable lending opportunities and potential customers.
• Maintain accurate records of loan applications, approvals, customer communications, and credit decisions.
• Prepare regular reports on loan applications, portfolio performance, approval rates, and credit risk.
• Escalate high-risk or complex applications to senior management or the appropriate credit authority.
• Contribute to improvements in credit assessment procedures, lending processes, and customer experience.
✅ Requirements • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Banking, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Previous experience in credit analysis, lending, banking, financial services, underwriting, or loan operations.
• Strong understanding of credit assessment principles and lending procedures.
• Good knowledge of financial statements, credit reports, financial ratios, and cash-flow analysis.
• Strong analytical and numerical skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Ability to assess financial information and make sound credit recommendations.
• Strong understanding of credit risk and risk mitigation practices.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and customer service skills.
• Ability to explain complex financial and loan-related information clearly to customers.
• Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other financial or credit analysis systems.
• Familiarity with CRM, loan origination, credit scoring, or banking systems is an advantage.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills.
• Ability to manage multiple loan applications and deadlines effectively.
• High level of integrity and professionalism when handling confidential financial information.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
• Strong knowledge of applicable lending, financial, and regulatory requirements is an advantage.
• Banking, credit, lending, or financial industry certifications are an advantage.
• Previous experience handling consumer, SME, commercial, or corporate lending portfolios is a plus.
🌟 What We Offer • Competitive salary with attractive performance-based incentives.
• Professional training in credit analysis, lending, and financial risk management.
• Opportunities to work with a diverse range of loan products and customer profiles.
• Career development opportunities within banking and financial services.
• Exposure to credit risk, underwriting, portfolio management, and lending operations.
• Supportive and collaborative working environment.
• Opportunities to develop strong relationships with customers and business partners.
• Access to professional learning and industry development programs.
• Performance recognition and reward opportunities.
• Opportunities for advancement into Senior Credit Analyst, Credit Manager, Relationship Manager, or Lending Manager positions.
